text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, as I'm walking down the
hallway...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I turn towards the source of the yelling
and see a
student sliding down the
staircase railing at full
speed.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Hey, wait! Come back here, you!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: We're playing tag, and I'm it!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I was chasing her with everything I've
got, but I
still somehow lost her!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
The railing? Ah... She rode down the
railing just
now, didn't she?!
choice_data_list: How about trying to anticipate their moves?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
No wonder she disappeared so fast!
What an
amazing idea! Thanks for the
help!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Winning Ticket rushes off with a
determined look
on her face.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Predict? Predict, huh... Ah! I got it!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I bet she's been running at full speed
too! Which
means I need to go at even
FULLER speed! Woo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Winning Ticket rushes off with a
determined look
on her face.
